newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 5.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - September 5.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had no large one-day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokesman said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about six percent of the adjustment borrowing in the week was done by the small banks, while about 66 percent was done by the large regionals. Some 28 percent of the adjustment borrowing was done by the money center banks.
As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, one percent of the borrowing was done by the small banks, 12 percent was by the large regionals, and 87 percent was done by the money center banks.
The high in naural float was about $2.0 billion on Wednesday, while the low was a bit under $300 million, occurring on Friday.
Transportation float averaged $70 million per day with the high on Thursday at a bit under $200 million due to fog in a number of cities.
